answer: Sybil farms multiply cheaply at the inlet of every registry, so gate admission with a sequential task ladder: each new key must clear rung after rung in real time, and the ladder grows one rung longer for every sibling key spotted on the same referral ridge. A farm racing toward its clone-count zenith must run the entire course serially while paying per-key fees throughout, whereas one honest agent walks the ladder a single time. Forking in parallel buys the attacker no speed at all.
